BlastRadius.description: BlastRadius is validate.BlastRadius as the report writes it.

devices.description: Devices is the number of distinct devices any task targets.

tiers.description: Tiers are the distinct tier properties among them.

Gap.description: Gap is a change the plan does not undo, and why.

device.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device the node changed, when one.

device_id.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device the node changed, when one.

node.description: Node is the node, in the run being undone, whose change this is.

reason.description: Reason says why the plan does not undo it.

PlanSection.description: PlanSection is one of pretasks, tasks and posttasks.

section.description: Section is "pretasks", "tasks" or "posttasks". Known values: pretasks, tasks, posttasks. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

tasks.description: Tasks are the section's tasks, in order.

PlanTask.description: PlanTask is one authored task, with the groups nested under it.

always.description: Always is a block's always tasks, run however Block ended.

block.description: Block is a block's own tasks.

id.description: ID is the task's node id (tasks[0], tasks[1].block[0]).

kind.description: Kind is "block" or "parallel" for a group, empty otherwise. Known values: block, parallel. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

method.description: Method is the method or action it calls; empty for a group.

name.description: Name is the task's name, which may be empty.

parallel.description: Parallel is a parallel group's tasks, run side by side.

rescue.description: Rescue is a block's rescue tasks, run when one of Block fails.

selected.description: Selected is false for a task --tags or --skip-tags left out.

Problem.description: Problem is one reason the plan was refused.

accept.description: Accept names the flag, and its argument, that accepts this problem, empty when nothing can.

device.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device it concerns, when one.

device_id.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device it concerns, when one.

kind.description: Kind says which sort of refusal this is when there are several to tell apart: one of the Kind constants for a later run, empty for every other refusal.

node.description: Node is the node, in the run being undone, the problem is about, when one.

reason.description: Reason says why the plan was refused.

Provider.description: Provider is where a method's code comes from when it is not compiled into this binary: an external Collection program.

Digest.description: Digest is the SHA-256 digest ("sha256:<hex>") the program was loaded with.

Program.description: Program is the path of the external Collection program.

ProvisionalStep.description: ProvisionalStep is one step whose check is provisional, and why.

device.description: Device is the name of the device the step runs on.

name.description: Name is the step's task name in the rollback run.

reason.description: Reason says which earlier step changes the device first.

RollbackReport.description: RollbackReport is a rollback's own part of the run report.

already_undone.description: AlreadyUndone are changes an earlier rollback of the run undid.

left.description: Left are changes left in place, by --leave.

levels.description: Levels are the undo's tasks in the order they run.

nothing_to_undo.description: NothingToUndo are changes whose task's rollback: list is empty: its runbook says undoing them means doing nothing.

problems.description: Problems are why the rollback was refused, when it was.

provisional.description: Provisional are, in a check, the steps on a device an earlier step of the rollback changes first: their checks meet the device as it is now.

unaccepted_unknown.description: UnacceptedUnknown counts Unknown not named with --allow-unknown.

unknown.description: Unknown are effects nobody can say were changes: failed actions and an unsealed journal.

RunOutcome.description: RunOutcome is how a run ended, with the status the command exits with.

allowed_unchecked.description: AllowedUnchecked names the unchecked tasks --allow-unchecked allowed, each as its node id and its device's name ("tasks[3] [r1]").

exit_code.description: ExitCode is the command's exit status.

message.description: Message is the line the text view ends with.

status.description: Status is complete, rescued, failed, incomplete, invalid or error. Known values: complete, rescued, failed, incomplete, invalid, error. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

unchecked.description: Unchecked counts tasks a check did not cover and nothing allowed.

RunWarning.description: RunWarning is something about the run as a whole that the person running it has to know, shown in the text view and kept in --json.

devices.description: Devices names the devices the two runs share.

kind.description: Kind is concurrent_run, concurrent_change or concurrent_unknown. Known values: concurrent_run, concurrent_change, concurrent_unknown. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

message.description: Message is the line the text view prints.

pid.description: PID is the other run's process, for a concurrent_run.

run_id.description: RunID names the other run, for a concurrent_change: what `pleiades journal show` takes.

runbook.description: Runbook is what the other run runs.

when.description: When is "start" for what the run found as it began, "end" for what it found as it ended. Known values: start, end. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

Step.description: Step is one task of a rollback run.

become.description: Become is the account the step runs its commands as, the account the node ran as: empty when it ran as its login.

device.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device the step runs on: the one the node changed.

device_id.description: DeviceID and DeviceName name the device the step runs on: the one the node changed.

emitter.description: Emitter is the method the node ran: what recorded the undo, or whose runbook task carries the rollback: list.

index.description: Index is the step's place in the node's undo: 0 for a recorded undo, its position in the rollback: list for an authored one.

method.description: FQCN and Params are the task to run.

name.description: Name is the task's name in the rollback run.

node.description: Node is the node, in the run being undone, this step undoes.

params.description: FQCN and Params are the task to run.

partial.description: Partial marks a recorded undo that does not put everything back, run because the operator named it in AllowPartial.

source.description: Source says where the step came from: "recorded" or "authored".

TaskReport.description: TaskReport is one task's result on one device. Every text in it that came from a device or a method is masked.

allowed_unchecked.description: AllowedUnchecked marks an unchecked task --allow-unchecked accepts.

device.description: Device is the device's inventory id (a UUID), empty for a controller-side task and for a task that never ran. It stays the id by contract, since a name can change and be reused; Host is the name.

error.description: Error is a failed task's error.

host.description: Host is the device's inventory name, the one a person reads.

id.description: ID is the task's node id.

ignored.description: Ignored marks a failure of a task that sets ignore_errors: it is a failure here and in the journal, and the run went on past it.

label.description: Label is the loop_control label of the item this result is, when the task is a loop and its author wrote one. The item's own value is never reported, since it may be a secret.

method.description: Method is the method or action it called.

name.description: Name is the task's name, which may be empty.

provider.description: Provider names the external program that ran the method, if one did.

reason.description: Reason is why a task was skipped, could not be checked, or was never run.

rescued_by.description: RescuedBy names the first task of the rescue: that answered this failed task's failure; the run went on past it.

retried.description: Retried marks a failure the task tried again; only its last try fails the task.

started_at.description: StartedAt is when the task's own execution began.

stats.description: Stats is everything the task reported, masked.

status.description: Status is what the task did. Known values: ok, changed, would_change, checked_only, failed, held, skipped, unchecked, conditional_skip, not_run. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

undoes.description: Undoes names the task this one undid: a step of a block's rollback_on_failure, which undid what the block's tasks completed when one of them failed. Its id is that task's, with .undo[step].

unreached.description: Unreached marks a failed task whose device never answered: its connection failed or timed out before anything was sent, so nothing ran and running it again is safe. A refused login is not unreached.

warnings.description: Warnings are what the person running the work has to act on.

device.description: Device is the inventory id of the device it concerns, if one.

host.description: Host is that device's inventory name.

node.description: Node is the task it refused.

rule.description: Rule names the rule that refused the runbook.

description: RunReport is one run, as both views print it. Printed by pleiades run, adhoc and rollback --json. schema_version is the major version: it goes up only for a change an existing reader could misread, a field removed or renamed or given another type or meaning. Within a major version a newer producer may add fields, and new values to the open sets. So a reader ignores a field it does not know, treats a status or kind it does not know as not a pass, and refuses a major version it does not know.

blast_radius.description: BlastRadius is how many devices the run targets.

inventory_hosts.description: InventoryHosts is how many devices the inventory holds.

journal.description: Journal is the path of this run's journal file, empty when RunID is.

metadata.description: Metadata is what set_metadata tasks recorded, masked.

mode.description: Mode is execute or check, after check_mode in the runbook is applied. Known values: execute, check. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

nodes.description: Nodes is how many tasks the runbook compiled to.

outcome.description: Outcome is how the run ended.

plan.description: Plan is the authored task tree, section by section.

rollback.description: Rollback is, for `pleiades rollback`, what it planned: the run it undoes, what it leaves in place, what nobody can say changed, and, when it refused, why.

run_id.description: RunID names this run in its journal, and is what `pleiades rollback` and `pleiades journal show` take. Empty for a check, which writes no journal, and for a run that never started.

runbook.description: Runbook names what ran: the runbook's path, or the ad-hoc call.

schema_version.description: SchemaVersion is this report's major version, RunReportVersion.

selection.description: Selection is the --tags and --skip-tags that chose the tasks.

service_effecting.description: ServiceEffecting is the runbook's own declaration.

tasks.description: Tasks is each task's result on each device, in the executor's order.

validation.description: Validation is what stopped the run before it started.

warnings.description: Warnings are about the run as a whole: another run changing the same devices when it started (concurrent_run), or a change another run journaled to them while it worked (concurrent_change). A check has none, since it changes nothing.

title: Pleiades run report
